job.title: Automate Daily News Summaries for 50 Companies
job.description: We are seeking a skilled freelancer to automate the process of gathering and summarizing news for a portfolio of 50 companies. The task involves using AI to filter and summarize news, and updating text files in folders for each company. Daily and weekly recap emails are required.

proposal.text:
Hello Kartik,

I’m very interested in helping you automate your news gathering and summarization workflow for the 50-company portfolio. I’ve actually completed a very similar project, where I built a Python-based system that automatically fetched daily news using the News API, classified each article by topic (e.g., macroeconomics, company updates, and opinions), summarized them using Groq LLM, and then emailed a daily digest.

The system handled:
- Automatic news retrieval and categorization
- AI-based summarization and relevance scoring
- Secure storage using SQLite
- Automated email delivery of daily/weekly summaries

I also worked on a patent monitoring automation, where the system periodically scraped and summarized newly filed patents, ensuring consistent and structured updates — similar to the multi-company tracking you’re aiming for.

For your project, I can:
- Set up automated scraping and AI summarization per company
- Store summaries in text files within their respective folders
- Schedule daily and weekly email recaps
- Ensure secure handling of API keys and credentials

Would you like the updates to be delivered via Gmail or a custom SMTP setup?
